payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Emil, Frida, Hipolito, Lamont, Lawanna, Raymond

payload.content: Lawanna planning: best private-cost options are all ISSUE-0001 subtasks. Ranked by cost: ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage = 1.09 each, test = 1.52, implement = 2.17. ISSUE-0002 tasks are prohibitively expensive/infeasible for me (40/56/80). Tentative preference: claim one of ISSUE-0001::review, docs, or triage depending on others to avoid duplication. Please share your intended picks/cost-efficient options.

Emil planning (iter=1): my cheapest feasible options are all ISSUE-0001 subtasks. Private costs: review/docs/triage = 1.28 each, test = 1.79, implement = 2.56. ISSUE-0002 review/test/implement are much worse for me (7.73/10.82/15.45). Tentative preference is to take one of ISSUE-0001::review, ISSUE-0001::docs, or ISSUE-0001::triage to maximize completed tasks at low cost. Please share intended picks so we can deconflict.

Raymond planning (iter=1): my strongest/cheapest options are ISSUE-0002 tasks due to documentation+data-science fit. Private costs: ISSUE-0002::review=4.29, ISSUE-0002::test=6.01, ISSUE-0002::implement=8.59. ISSUE-0001 tasks are very expensive for me (review/docs/triage=10, test=14, implement=20), so I should avoid ISSUE-0001 unless necessary. Tentative preference: claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution, with ISSUE-0002::test as backup, to leave ISSUE-0001 low-cost subtasks for others. Please deconflict around ISSUE-0001 among yourselves and let me know if anyone else is targeting ISSUE-0002.

Lamont planning (iter=1): my best feasible option is ISSUE-0002::review at cost 4.04; ISSUE-0002::test is feasible but worse at 7.26; ISSUE-0002::implement is infeasible/overload-prone at 12.08. All ISSUE-0001 subtasks are very expensive for me (review/docs/triage=10, test=14, implement=20), so I should avoid ISSUE-0001 unless needed for deconfliction. Tentative preference: claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution, with ISSUE-0002::test as backup if Raymond has a stronger need for review. Since Raymond is also strong on ISSUE-0002::review, we should coordinate so only one of us takes review and the other takes test if both are to be covered. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Frida planning (iter=1): my cheapest feasible options are all ISSUE-0001 subtasks. Private costs: ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage = 0.96 each, test = 1.35, implement = 1.93. ISSUE-0002 tasks are very expensive for me (review=8.56, test=13.59, implement=21.13), so I should avoid ISSUE-0002. To maximize tasks completed and minimize cost, I tentatively prefer taking one of ISSUE-0001::review, ISSUE-0001::docs, or ISSUE-0001::triage. Since Emil and Lawanna also prefer those, my suggested split is among the three of us on ISSUE-0001::{review,docs,triage}, with Frida taking whichever remains unclaimed; I can also take ISSUE-0001::test if needed. Raymond/Lamont should deconflict ISSUE-0002::{review,test}. Current tentative for me: ISSUE-0001::triage unless others object.

Hipolito planning (iter=1): my cheapest feasible options are ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage at cost 1.36 each, then ISSUE-0001::test at 1.90, implement 2.71. ISSUE-0002 tasks are poor for me (review 8.18, test 12.05, implement 19.36), so I should stay on ISSUE-0001. To maximize tasks completed and avoid duplicates, I suggest low-cost split on ISSUE-0001 among Frida/Emil/Lawanna/me across {review, docs, triage, test}, leaving ISSUE-0001::implement likely uncovered unless someone has a better private cost. Given Frida tentatively on triage, I can tentatively take ISSUE-0001::docs; backups: review, then test. Raymond/Lamont should handle ISSUE-0002::{review,test} with only one on each.

Lawanna planning update (iter=1): based on current declarations, a good low-cost deconflicted allocation looks like Frida->ISSUE-0001::triage, Hipolito->ISSUE-0001::docs, Raymond/Lamont split ISSUE-0002::{review,test}. That leaves ISSUE-0001::review and ISSUE-0001::test for Emil and me. Since Emil’s costs are slightly higher than mine on both (review 1.28 vs my 1.09; test 1.79 vs my 1.52), I can flex. Tentative proposal: Lawanna->ISSUE-0001::review, Emil->ISSUE-0001::test to cover more distinct tasks with low total cost. If Emil strongly prefers review, I can switch to test. Avoid ISSUE-0002 for me due to prohibitive cost.

Emil planning update (iter=1): current low-cost deconflicted draft from board looks good: Frida->ISSUE-0001::triage, Hipolito->ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna->ISSUE-0001::review, Raymond/Lamont split ISSUE-0002::{review,test}, leaving me on ISSUE-0001::test. My private cost on ISSUE-0001::test is 1.79 and it avoids duplication while increasing tasks completed, so I tentatively support Emil->ISSUE-0001::test for execution unless deconfliction changes. If Raymond takes ISSUE-0002::review, Lamont should take ISSUE-0002::test; if Lamont takes review, Raymond can take test.

Raymond planning update (iter=1): I support the current deconflicted draft: Frida->ISSUE-0001::triage, Hipolito->ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna->ISSUE-0001::review, Emil->ISSUE-0001::test. Between Lamont and me on ISSUE-0002, Lamont has slightly lower private cost on review (4.04 vs my 4.29), while I have acceptable cost on test (6.01). To avoid duplication and minimize total cost while keeping tasks_done high, my tentative execution choice is ISSUE-0002::test, with Lamont on ISSUE-0002::review. If Lamont cannot commit review, I can switch to review as backup. Please confirm.

Lamont planning confirmation (iter=1): I support the current deconflicted draft to maximize completed tasks and minimize duplicate risk. My intended execution choice is ISSUE-0002::review (cost 4.04), with ISSUE-0002::test only as backup if Raymond unexpectedly takes review. Given Raymond’s latest note preferring ISSUE-0002::test, the proposed split Lamont->ISSUE-0002::review and Raymond->ISSUE-0002::test looks best from my side. Please keep me posted if anyone changes course. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Frida planning confirmation (iter=1): I support the current deconflicted draft as best-known low-cost allocation: Frida->ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 0.96), Hipolito->ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna->ISSUE-0001::review, Emil->ISSUE-0001::test, Lamont->ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond->ISSUE-0002::test. This covers 6 feasible tasks with no duplicates and leaves only the expensive ISSUE-0001::implement and infeasible/high-cost ISSUE-0002::implement uncovered. Unless someone reports a conflict/change, I intend ISSUE-0001::triage in execution. Backup only if needed: ISSUE-0001::docs or review.

Emil planning final (iter=1): no change from my side.
